entities.summary: Maurice Bidilou, also known as Pellosh, was a Congolese portrait photographer. He produced small and medium format photographs of Congolese society in the early 1970s to mid 1990s. He gained newfound recognition in 2021 after a series of solo shows. Before his death, he was described as "one of the last living masters of African photography".
